notes: API: services.publix.com/api/v1/PurchaseHistory (list) + /detail?transactionKey=. Auth is a Bearer AccessTokenJwt cookie plus EcmsId header (Azure B2C, ~1h token life). Detail returns Products, ReceiptLineItems, tenders, totals, barcode, and ReceiptText — the same receipt text the email parser consumes, so api/ and email/ share normalize/. timeZone is the zone receipt times are read in; stores in the Central zone print Central time.
